title: CodeNest Coding Platform
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.fonts: all three required families loaded locally
interactions: desktop navigation: all 4 links open details; Escape closes
Get Started opens learning path; close and return controls work
mobile full-screen menu: open, close button, Escape, link selection
reduced motion: poster instead of autoplay

asset_issues.handling: Built from the complete written prompt; no screenshot extraction or reference-match claim.

notes: React + Tailwind CSS + hls.js (enableWorker: false) + lucide-react.
Required Mux stream played successfully; runtime streaming requires Mux connectivity.
Poster comes from the same video; required fonts are self-hosted.
CTA and navigation open local informational dialogs; no enrollment endpoint was specified.
Build has a nonfatal Vite large-chunk advisory due to the HLS library.
Chromium verification only; shorter viewports may scroll vertically.
No deployment, push, other design access, or agent delegation.
